Why Rockwall businesses miss calls

Rockwall is the county seat of Rockwall County, on the east side of Lake Ray Hubbard. Median household income is about $116,000, and education and health care employ over a quarter of workers. The Harbor district draws diners and visitors, while newer neighborhoods bring constant home service work. Spanish use is among the lowest of the Texas cities we cover, so a clear English script may be all you need.

Can you keep your Rockwall phone number?

Yes. Rockwall callers will usually see the 214, 469, 972 and 945 area codes, and you can keep the number customers already know. Forward it to the AI for all calls, only after hours, or only when your team does not pick up. We can also set up a new local number. Everything is set up remotely, so you do not need new equipment or a visit to an office.

What to check before you go live

  1. Test real calls: ask awkward questions, not only easy ones, and listen to how it handles them.
  2. Set the rules: decide which calls transfer to a person and which become messages.
  3. Plan your minutes: estimate your busiest month, not an average one.
  4. Tell callers what you need to: Texas is generally treated as a one-party consent state for recording calls, but rules differ for callers in other states, so check with your advisor if you record calls.
